A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Variational Diffusion Unlearning (VDU) study. Their main text, equations, tables, figures, and complete Appendices A.1–A.4 support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: V1 reports original class-unlearning experiments, CelebA feature-unlearning results, Stable Diffusion examples, and ablations in the main text and appendices.

after.justification: V2 retains these original quantitative and qualitative experiments, including the results in Tables 1–6 and the appendix examples.

M1.justification: Equation 2 replaces the plasticity term's explicit timestep sum with an expectation containing the timestep-dependent weight. This is a localized revision of the stated objective; the variational framework, stability regularizer, and update algorithm remain. Whether the implementation changed is not established.

E1.justification: Both versions cover MNIST, CIFAR-10, and tinyImageNet class unlearning, CelebA attributes, and Stable Diffusion style/object unlearning. The car example highlighted in v2 already appears in v1's appendix.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains Fine-tuning, Selective Amnesia, SalUn, and ESD; Table 4 retains Fine-tuning, SalUn, and ESD. The documented adaptations restricting baseline access to retained data are unchanged.

E3.justification: The reported evaluation settings remain unchanged: PUL and u-FID, 5,000 generated samples for PUL, limited-epoch baseline selection, and the training and unlearning settings in Appendix A.4. The loss revision is a method change, without a separately documented protocol revision.

E4.justification: The documented gamma sweeps, loss-component ablation, checkpoint-count analyses, and qualitative cases are retained. V1's Appendix A.2.3/Figure 5 moves to Section 4.4.2/Figure 6; v2's new Figure 4 redisplays existing appendix sequences.

E5.justification: Checkpoint and independent-training counts are unchanged. Both versions report performance as point estimates without adding confidence intervals, significance tests, or run-to-run performance uncertainty.

E6.justification: V2 removes Appendix A.1.4's qualitative finding that the extra timestep-summed term produces faster convergence and better empirical performance. All numerical entries in Tables 1–6 remain unchanged, and the rearranged visual examples reuse evidence already present in v1.

T1.justification: Appendix A.1.4 moves the timestep weight inside the expectation in Equation 68 and removes the subsequent derivation introducing the additional summed term A. The lemmas, Theorem 3.3, their proofs, and the Gaussian and equal-variance assumptions remain unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions: variationally formulated diffusion unlearning using only forget data, a plasticity/stability objective, and effectiveness across class and feature unlearning.

C2.justification: V2 removes the argument that reintroducing the timestep sum better captures the full diffusion path in Appendix A.1.4. Interpretations of the retained experiments and limitations concerning Gaussian assumptions, checkpoint dependence, and feature entanglement remain unchanged.

D1.justification: The appendices retain the same checkpoint-estimation instructions, optimizers, hyperparameters, hardware, timing and memory information, classifiers, and code/data access links. No additional reproducibility information accompanies the revised loss.

R1.justification: The cited works and research positioning are unchanged, including the relationships to Selective Amnesia, SalUn, ESD, and variational inference.

P1.justification: Sections 3.2 and 3.3 receive more descriptive headings, 'Visual Results' becomes 'Qualitative Results,' and the loss-component ablation discussion moves into the main text. Most prose and the overall section structure remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 3 is compacted and includes an existing car example; new Figure 4 combines previously shown appendix sequences. Other figures are relocated or renumbered, and the gamma-plot caption is corrected to name only its displayed MNIST and CIFAR-10 datasets.

improvement.justification: V2 makes existing visual and ablation evidence more accessible in the main text. However, Equation 2 and Appendix A.1.4 revise the loss while Figure 2 retains the earlier summed form and all numerical results remain unchanged. The PDFs do not explain whether this corrects the description or changes the implemented objective underlying those results. This unresolved methodological consistency issue prevents a reliable net quality judgment.
